description: Performance and bundle size budgets for Neo Meta Harness. Deterministic budgets are enforced by scripts/perf-budgets.mjs during pnpm check; runtime budgets are measured by specific exit tests.

deterministic.name: Docs Site Total Distribution (gzip)
